expect.why: the view holds the whole of notebook.md
the view shows notebook.md from its first line

steps.line: * When the user selects its first line and types "x"

expect.why: the triple click selected the first line, with its line break if it has one

steps.line: * Then the first line is still selected

expect.why: the selection after typing still covers the first line, with its line break if it has one

steps.line: * And the text in the view is unchanged

expect.why: typing added or removed no characters

expect.that: def whole: .length as $n | [.drawn[] | select(.offset < $n)] | if length == 1 and .[0].offset == 0 and (.[0].text | length) == $n then .[0].text else null end; (.opened.json.sections.notebook | whole) as $before | $before != null and (.typed.json.sections.notebook | whole) == $before
expect.why: notebook.md has no line break, so before and after typing one drawn paragraph spans the whole text, every character of it observed and none reconstructed, and that text is the same
